title: 第1166章 一举四得第1165章 害人不成反害己
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
凤凰池烈焰翻涌，赤金色的火浪如亿万只涅盘神凤在虚空中振翅啼鸣，每一缕蒸腾的雾气都是由极度浓缩的火属性本源所化。
呼吸之间，连神魂都似要被那纯粹到极致的焚天道韵点燃、熔炼。
李易端坐火心。
任由无尽凤凰神火洗练己身，以纯阳之火煅骨炼血、提纯本命神火，层层打磨稳固神格、凝练神魂，令神火、神格、神魂尽快三位一体，夯实天神境圆满的根基，积淀雄厚底蕴，为冲击神君境做准备。
炎魔鳄龙本是火道魔躯，最是擅长吸收火系净化成长。
此刻。
在九星顶级神火的滋养下，恰好完美克制它体内盘踞已久的阴寒煞毒。
万千火道本源丝丝缕缕钻入鳞甲、浸透全身各处，不断冲刷破败经脉、修复受损本源。
让它沉寂已久的龙火血脉飞速复苏，伤势以肉眼可见的速度愈合，蛰伏的破境契机也被彻底点燃。
李易元府内。
小白虎浑身火纹炽亮，通体绒毛被纯粹的神火浸染得金灿灿一片，张口便是狂风卷火，疯狂掠夺周遭肆意奔腾的火属性本源。
体内火韵暴涨，血脉根基被不断夯实，不断实现进化。
陡然间，它灵动的虎眸猛地圆睁，惊呼道：
“主人！底下有大家伙！”
它凝神探查池底深处，火属性本源的脉络在它眼中无所遁形，随即急促出声：
“是火系大道原石！
整块地底都被它贯通，蕴藏无尽火道本源！而且这凤凰池底蕴太过恐怖，曾经竟诞生过一尊先天火精灵，只是早已不知所踪，应该是被顶尖大能收服带走了！”
一旁。
大蟑螂缓缓舒展虫躯，感受着四面八方厚重得近乎凝固的火道规则，低声感慨：
“难怪这凤凰池神火霸道绝伦、冠绝八星，不止依托上古凤凰仙血滋养，更有火系大道原石坐镇地底源源不断赋能。

合欢宗能稳居仙女宗前三，这份深藏不露的底蕴，当真骇人。”
闻言。
李易闭目修炼的身躯微微一震，心底掀起滔天波澜。
他拜入合欢宗的目标之一，便是寻觅火系大道原石，补全鸿蒙塔缺失的火系大道根基，完善自身五道本源。
原本以为需要耗费不少精力与时日，才能找到，却没想到，入宗短短两日，便在这凤凰池得偿所愿。
“主人，让我带小塔去火池底部吞噬火系大道本源吧。”
小白虎眼神炽热，战意与兴奋交织，主动请缨。
“好。”
李易没有半分迟疑，当即答应。
他深知小白虎的火道天赋得天独厚，天生万火亲和，这凤凰池的极致神火与火道威压，对旁人是灭顶之灾，对它却是无上温床。
同时通过他的以往经验判断。
沧海神宫、神剑宗、神女宗的大道原石，都是为了滋养弟子道基、传承大道，一般只设定限制搬移的禁制，而不设其他限制。
合欢宗应该也是如此。
换句话说，只要获得资格进入凤凰池，任何修士都可以随便吸纳池底大道原石的道韵，而不会被监视。
一念及此。
李易立即催动神识，将悬浮识海的鸿蒙塔移入元府，开启塔门。
小白虎身形一闪，掠入塔内。
content_en:
The flames of the Phoenix Pond are surging, and the red-gold fire waves are like billions of nirvana phoenixes flapping their wings and crowing in the void. Every wisp of steaming mist is formed by the extremely concentrated fire attribute origin.
Between the breaths, even the soul seemed to be ignited and melted by the pure and pure Burning Heaven Dao Yun.
Li Yi sat in the heart of the fire.
Let the endless phoenix divine fire cleanse your body, use the pure Yang fire to forge bones and blood, purify the natal divine fire, polish and stabilize the divine personality step by step, condense the divine soul, and make the divine fire, divine personality, and divine soul become the trinity as soon as possible, consolidate the foundation of the perfection of the heavenly realm, accumulate a rich foundation, and prepare for the impact of the divine king realm.
The Flame Demon Crocodile Dragon is originally a fire demon body, and it is best at absorbing the fire element to purify and grow.
now.
Nourished by the nine-star top divine fire, it perfectly suppresses the cold evil poison that has been entrenched in its body for a long time.
Thousands of filaments of fire origin penetrated into the scales and penetrated every part of the body, constantly washing away the broken meridians and repairing the damaged origin.
The dragon fire bloodline that had been dormant for a long time was quickly revived, the injuries healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the dormant opportunity to break through was completely ignited.
Inside Li Yiyuan's mansion.
The little white tiger's body was covered with blazing fire patterns, and the fur all over its body was soaked in pure divine fire and turned golden. When it opened its mouth, the wind rolled into fire, and it crazily plundered the fire attribute source that was rushing around.
The fire energy in the body surges, the foundation of the bloodline is continuously consolidated, and evolution continues.
Suddenly, its smart tiger eyes widened suddenly and exclaimed:
"Master! There's a big guy down there!"
It concentrated on exploring the depths of the pool, and the veins of the origin of the fire attribute were nowhere to be seen in its eyes, and then it hurriedly said:
“It’s the fire element avenue rough stone!
The entire ground is penetrated by it, containing the origin of endless fire! Moreover, the foundation of this Phoenix Pond is too terrifying. An innate fire elf was once born, but it has long since disappeared. It must have been conquered and taken away by a top power! "
aside.
The big cockroach slowly stretched its body, feeling the thick and almost solid fire rules in all directions, and sighed in a low voice:
"No wonder this Phoenix Pond Divine Fire is extremely domineering and tops the eight stars. Not only is it nourished by the blood of the ancient Phoenix Immortal, but it is also continuously empowered by the raw stones of the Fire Element Avenue sitting in the ground.
The Hehuan Sect can firmly rank in the top three of the Fairy Sect. This hidden secret is really shocking. "
Hear the words.
Li Yi's body shook slightly as he closed his eyes and practiced, and a huge wave of waves arose in his heart.
One of his goals in joining the Hehuan Sect was to find the original stone of the Fire Element Avenue, to complete the missing Fire Element Avenue foundation of Hongmeng Tower, and to perfect his five origins.
I originally thought that it would take a lot of energy and time to find it, but I didn't expect that in just two days after joining the sect, I would get what I wanted in the Phoenix Pond.
"Master, let me take Xiaota to the bottom of the fire pool to devour the origin of the fire avenue."
The little white tiger's eyes were blazing, fighting spirit and excitement intertwined, and he took the initiative to ask for help.
"Okay."
Li Yi agreed immediately without any hesitation.
He knew very well that the little white tiger was endowed with a unique talent for fire, and was born with a natural affinity for all fires. The ultimate divine fire and fire pressure of the Phoenix Pond was a disaster to others, but it was a supreme breeding ground for it.
At the same time, judge based on his past experience.
The raw stones of the Great Dao of the Canghai Shrine, the Divine Sword Sect, and the Goddess Sect are all intended to nourish the disciples' Dao foundation and inherit the Dao. Generally, they only set restrictions on their relocation, and no other restrictions are set.
The same should be true for Hehuan Sect.
In other words, as long as they are qualified to enter the Phoenix Pool, any monk can absorb the Taoist charm of the original stone at the bottom of the pool without being monitored.
Just think of this.
Li Yi immediately activated his spiritual consciousness, moved the Hongmeng Tower suspended in the sea of ​​consciousness into Yuan Mansion, and opened the tower door.
The little white tiger flashed and entered the tower.
